I will plant sorghum on this half-hectare plot this season because the rains look favorable for it. I plan to buy two bags of DAP and one bag of urea from the cooperative to give the soil some strength, but I will sow my own saved seed since improved sorghum is hard to find and costly here. My wife and children will help with planting, weeding, and harvest, so we do not need to hire outside workers for a plot of this size.
